hook.text: How does the circle of fifths work?

text.formula: Each step up is a perfect fifth: one more ♯
Neighbours on the wheel make the chords of a key
Seven neighbours in a row are a major scale
Inside the wheel: each key’s minor twin
Twelve fifths never quite close the circle

hook.text: What are the roots of unity?

text.formula: z^n = 1 has n roots: they make a regular polygon
Gold: the roots that can build all the others
The powers of one root draw a star
Multiplying by i turns a quarter turn
All the roots add up to zero

hook.text: Why do some chords belong together?

text.formula: Pop: I V vi IV, all neighbours of C
Pachelbel’s Canon in D stays close too

hook.text: What does multiplying by a complex number do?

text.formula: Multiply by i: a quarter turn
Multiply by e^(i·60°): a sixth of a turn
Sine and cosine: the two shadows of the point
